description: This file defines a database migration class for version 5.2.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for schema modifications, permission and language string updates, configuration settings, and related migration tasks specific to this version upgrade.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class that manages database schema updates and data modifications for the OrangeHRM version 5.2.0 upgrade, including schema changes, permission insertions, language string updates, configuration adjustments, and related tasks.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the database schema updates, data insertions, deletions, and configuration changes to upgrade OrangeHRM to version 5.2.0.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration, '5.2.0'.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LangStringHelper instance used for handling language string operations.

methods.name: updatePimLeftMenuConfigurators
methods.description: Updates the configuration of the PIM module's left menu to set the correct menu configurator class.

methods.name: updateOrganizationStructure
methods.description: Updates the organization structure data based on the organization info.

methods.name: updateHomePage
methods.description: Updates the home page URL for a specified user role.

methods.name: insertLDAPMenuItem
methods.description: Inserts LDAP configuration menu item into the admin menu.

methods.name: cleanLDAPAddonData
methods.description: Removes LDAP-related data group, screen, and module entries from the database.

methods.name: insertLangStringNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from a YAML file and updates language strings with notes.

methods.name: cleanI18nGroups
methods.description: Cleans up specific internationalization groups and reassigns their language strings.
